name: context-meter
description: A context band above the prompt that warns on quality in tokens (200k fading, 350k dumb zone) and hands off there: a state doc, /clear, the doc read back. Details shows the /context breakdown, the prompt cache (share served, lifetime, time left), limits, cost and memory files, with model and effort switchers. All figures are real text and every bar keeps 3:1 contrast. Terminal, Desktop Code tab and VS Code.

cacheTtlMinutes.title: Prompt cache lifetime (minutes)
cacheTtlMinutes.description: How long an idle prompt cache entry lives. 0 reads it off the plan: 60 on a subscription seat, 5 on API or cloud-provider billing.
